Starts Agave validator boot, argument setup, CPU affinity, and sandboxed clone execution.

# Purpose
This file starts the `run-agave` action for Firedancer. It creates a cloned process for the Agave validator side, sets process and CPU affinity, joins the shared memory workspaces that Agave uses, and then starts the external validator entry point [`fd_ext_validator_main`](<#fd_ext_validator_main>). The code also handles debug stop behavior, UID and GID switching, and optional PID namespace isolation when sandbox mode is enabled.

The main work is in [`agave_boot`](<#agave_boot>), which builds the command line for `fdctl` from `config_t` fields. It maps network, consensus, ledger, gossip, RPC, snapshot, and scheduler settings into Agave command-line options, sets `SOLANA_METRICS_CONFIG` when needed, and exports development-only flags through [`fd_ext_larger_max_cost_per_block`](<#fd_ext_larger_max_cost_per_block>), [`fd_ext_larger_shred_limits_per_block`](<#fd_ext_larger_shred_limits_per_block>), and [`fd_ext_disable_status_cache`](<#fd_ext_disable_status_cache>). The file defines the `fd_action_run_agave` action object, so it serves as the command handler that launches the Agave validator process inside the Firedancer runtime.
